reason: The first order is cash at my door and Abu Ali's name is on the receipt, so I can try one small batch of phone accessories without risking a dinar. I'll test it once and compare against what I pay in Shorja.
objection: After the first order they want the money up front, and I don't pay a new name before the goods are in my hand. Also 21,000 in fees on a 30,000 item eats my whole resale margin.
would_change_my_mind: Keep cash on delivery for every order, not just the first, and I'd order for my shop regularly.
